name: Catamount Solar
old_description: At Catamount Solar, we deliver the advantages of solar energy to all of our commercial and residential  customers. Our employee-owners have a strong commitment to delivering the best possible renewable energy solutions to our customers every day. We bring decades of skill, experience, and enthusiasm to both residential and commercial solar. We provide good-paying jobs and profit sharing to our member owners. And we donate 5% of our profits to local community organizations.
about:
Catamount Solar, based in Randolph, Vermont, was established in 2011 as a worker-owned cooperative. The company began with a mission to help families, farms, and businesses reduce dependence on fossil-fuel energy through solar power. Ownership is structured as a member-owned cooperative where all workers are either members or on a track to become member-owners.

The cooperative designs and installs solar power systems for residential, commercial, off-grid, and battery backup applications. Its technicians bring decades of combined experience to each project, handling system design, installation, and ongoing service. The company does not disclose facility size or headcount, but emphasizes that employee ownership leads to low turnover and a stable, experienced installation crew.

Catamount Solar serves residential homeowners, agricultural operations, commercial businesses, and institutional clients such as schools. Notable projects include installations for Crossett Brook Middle School in Duxbury, and residential systems for customers in Woodstock and Thetford. The company works with clients of all sizes seeking energy independence and cost savings.

The cooperative model is central to its differentiation: employee-owners share profits through patronage dividends and participate in governance. Catamount Solar donates 5% of annual profits to Vermont community organizations. The ownership structure is intended to ensure long-term warranty support and continuity, as the company is less likely to be sold.
